units.zh: 梁書卷第十九 列傳第十三
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 19, Biographies 13
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 19, Biographies 13

units.zh: 宗夬 劉坦 樂藹
units.en: Zong Guai; Liu Tan; Yue Ai
units.literal: Zong Guai; Liu Tan; Yue Ai

units.zh: 宗夬字明敭，南陽涅陽人也，世居江陵。
units.en: Zong Guai, styled Mingyang, came from Nieyang in Nanyang; his line had long lived in Jiangling.
units.literal: Zong Guai, styled Mingyang, was a native of Nieyang in Nanyang; his family had long dwelt in Jiangling.

units.zh: 祖炳，宋時徵太子庶子不就，有高名。
units.en: His grandfather Bing, summoned in Song as crown prince attendant but never took the post, was widely esteemed.
units.literal: His grandfather Bing, in Song times summoned as crown prince attendant but did not accept, had a lofty name.

units.zh: 父繁，西中郎諮議參軍。
units.en: His father Fan served as staff adviser to the western army commander.
units.literal: His father Fan was a staff adviser to the western army commander.

units.zh: 夬少勤學，有局幹。
units.en: From youth Guai studied hard and showed both breadth and backbone.
units.literal: Guai from youth studied hard and had breadth and backbone.

units.zh: 弱冠，舉郢州秀才，歷臨川王常侍、驃騎行參軍。
units.en: At his capping he was named Yingzhou's outstanding talent, then served the Prince of Linchuan and the chief of staff's staff.
units.literal: At his capping he was recommended as Yingzhou's outstanding talent and served as attendant to the Prince of Linchuan, then as staff officer on the chief of staff's staff.

units.zh: 齊司徒竟陵王集學士于西邸，並見圖畫，夬亦預焉。
units.en: The Qi Minister over the Masses, the Prince of Jingling, gathered scholars at the Western Lodge and had them painted; Guai was there.
units.literal: The Qi Minister over the Masses, the Prince of Jingling, gathered scholars at the Western Lodge and had them painted; Guai was among them.

units.zh: 永明中，與魏和親，敕夬與尚書殿中郎任昉同接魏使，皆時選也。
units.en: When Qi made peace with Wei in Yongming, Guai and Palace Director Ren Fang were chosen to receive the Wei envoys—both were men of the hour.
units.literal: In Yongming, when peace was made with Wei, an edict had Guai and Palace Director Ren Fang receive the Wei envoys together—both were men of the moment.

units.zh: 武帝嫡孫南郡王居西州，以夬管書記，夬旣以筆札被知，亦以貞正見許，故任焉。
units.en: Emperor Wu's legitimate grandson, the Prince of Nan Commandery, resided at Xizhou and put Guai in charge of his documents; Guai was known for his brushwork and trusted for rectitude, so he was given the post.
units.literal: Emperor Wu's legitimate grandson, the Prince of Nan Commandery, resided at Xizhou and had Guai manage his documents; Guai was already known for writing and was also trusted for integrity, so he was appointed.

units.zh: 俄而文惠太子薨，王爲皇太孫，夬仍管書記。
units.en: Soon Crown Prince Wenhui died; the prince became imperial grandson, and Guai continued in charge of his documents.
units.literal: Soon Crown Prince Wenhui died; the prince became imperial grandson, and Guai continued to manage his documents.

units.zh: 及太孫卽位，多失德，夬頗自疏，得爲秣陵令，遷尚書都官郎。
units.en: When the imperial grandson took the throne, his conduct often failed; Guai kept his distance, became magistrate of Moling, and was then promoted to Director of the Bureau of Punishments.
units.literal: When the imperial grandson took the throne, he often failed in virtue; Guai kept his distance and managed to become magistrate of Moling, then was promoted to Director of the Bureau of Punishments in the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 隆昌末，少帝見誅，寵舊多罹其禍，惟夬及傅昭以清正免。
units.en: At the end of Longchang, the young emperor was killed, and many of his favored old associates were caught in the disaster; only Guai and Fu Zhao escaped because they were pure and upright.
units.literal: At the end of Longchang, the young emperor was killed; many favored old associates suffered the disaster, but only Guai and Fu Zhao escaped because they were pure and upright.

units.zh: 明帝卽位，以夬爲郢州治中，有名稱職，以父老去官還鄉里。
units.en: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Guai was made administrative aide of Yingzhou. He had a good reputation and was competent in office, but because his father was old he left office and returned to his village.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Guai was made administrative aide of Yingzhou. He had a good reputation and was competent in office, but because his father was old he left office and returned to his village.

units.zh: 南康王爲荊州刺史，引爲別駕。
units.en: When the Prince of Nankang became inspector of Jingzhou, he brought Guai in as aide-de-camp.
units.literal: When the Prince of Nankang became inspector of Jingzhou, he brought Guai in as aide-de-camp.

units.zh: 義師起，遷西中郎諮議參軍，別駕如故。
units.en: When the righteous army rose, Guai was promoted to advisory army aide to the Western Central Commandant, while remaining aide-de-camp as before.
units.literal: When the righteous army rose, Guai was promoted to advisory army aide to the Western Central Commandant, while remaining aide-de-camp as before.

units.zh: 時西土位望，惟夬與同郡樂藹、劉坦爲州人所推信，故領軍將軍蕭穎胄深相委仗，每事諮焉。
units.en: At the time, among men of rank and reputation in the western lands, only Guai, Yue Ai, and Liu Tan of the same commandery were trusted and recommended by the people of the province, so General of the Army Xiao Yingzhou relied deeply on them and consulted them on every matter.
units.literal: At the time, among men of rank and reputation in the western lands, only Guai, Yue Ai, and Liu Tan of the same commandery were trusted and recommended by the people of the province, so General of the Army Xiao Yingzhou relied deeply on them and consulted them on every matter.

units.zh: 高祖師發雍州，穎胄遣夬出自楊口，面稟經略，並護送軍資，高祖甚禮之。
units.en: When Gaozu's army set out from Yongzhou, Yingzhou sent Guai out by way of Yangkou to receive his strategy in person and escort military supplies; Gaozu treated him with great courtesy.
units.literal: When Gaozu's army set out from Yongzhou, Yingzhou sent Guai out by way of Yangkou to receive his strategy in person and escort military supplies; Gaozu treated him with great courtesy.

units.zh: 中興初，遷御史中丞，以父憂去職。
units.en: At the beginning of Zhongxing, Guai was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor, but left office for mourning his father.
units.literal: At the beginning of Zhongxing, Guai was promoted to Palace Assistant Censor, but left office for mourning his father.

units.zh: 起爲冠軍將軍、衛軍長史。
units.en: He was recalled as Champion General and chief clerk to the Guard General.
units.literal: He was recalled as Champion General and chief clerk to the Guard General.

units.zh: 天監元年，遷征虜長史、東海太守，將軍如故。
units.en: In Tianjian 1, he was transferred as chief clerk to the General Who Subdues Captives and administrator of Donghai, retaining his general's rank as before.
units.literal: In Tianjian 1, he was transferred as chief clerk to the General Who Subdues Captives and administrator of Donghai, retaining his general's rank as before.

units.zh: 二年，徵爲太子右衛率。
units.en: In the second year, he was summoned to be Crown Prince Right Guard Commander.
units.literal: In the second year, he was summoned to be Crown Prince Right Guard Commander.

units.zh: 是冬，遷五兵尚書，參掌大選。
units.en: That winter he was transferred to Minister of the Five Arms and took part in managing the great selection of officials.
units.literal: That winter he was transferred to Minister of the Five Arms and took part in managing the great selection of officials.

units.zh: 三年，卒，時年四十九。
units.en: He died in the third year, aged forty-nine.
units.literal: He died in the third year, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 子曜卿嗣。
units.en: His son Yaoqing inherited.
units.literal: His son Yaoqing inherited.

units.zh: 夬從弟岳，有名行，州裏稱之，出於夬右。
units.en: His cousin Yue was famed for conduct; the district praised him above Guai.
units.literal: Guai's cousin Yue had a famed conduct; the district praised him and ranked him above Guai.

units.zh: 仕歷尚書庫部郎，郢州治中，北中郎錄事參軍事。
units.en: He rose through Director of the Arsenal, Yingzhou chief clerk, and recorder on the northern army staff.
units.literal: In office he rose through Director of the Arsenal in the Masters of Writing, Yingzhou chief clerk, and recorder on the northern army commander's staff.

units.zh: 劉坦，字德度，南陽安衆人也，晉鎮東將軍喬之七世孫。
units.en: Liu Tan, styled Dedu, came from Anzhong in Nanyang, seventh in descent from Jin's eastern guardian Liu Qiao.
units.literal: Liu Tan, styled Dedu, was a native of Anzhong in Nanyang, seventh-generation descendant of Jin's general who guarded the east, Liu Qiao.

units.zh: 坦少爲從兄虯所知。
units.en: From youth his elder cousin Jiao knew him.
units.literal: From youth Tan was known to his elder cousin Jiao.

units.zh: 齊建元初，爲南郡王國常侍，尋補孱陵令，遷南中郎錄事參軍，所居以幹濟稱。
units.en: At Qi's Jianyuan opening he attended the Prince of Nan commandery, soon became Chanling magistrate, then southern army recorder, famed everywhere for capable rule.
units.literal: At the start of Jianyuan in Qi he was attendant to the Prince of Nan commandery; soon he supplemented as magistrate of Chanling, was promoted to recorder on the southern army staff, and where he served was praised for capable administration.

units.zh: 南康王爲荊州刺史，坦爲西中郎中兵參軍，領長流。
units.en: When the Prince of Nankang held Jingzhou, Tan was western staff middle army officer, leading the long current.
units.literal: When the Prince of Nankang was inspector of Jingzhou, Tan was middle army staff officer on the western staff, leading the long current.

units.zh: 義師起，遷諮議參軍。
units.en: When the Righteous Army rose, he became staff adviser.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army rose, he was promoted staff adviser.

units.zh: 時輔國將軍楊公則爲湘州刺史，帥師赴夏口，西朝議行州事者，坦謂衆曰：「湘境人情，易擾難信。
units.en: Supporting-the-state general Yang Gongze was Xiangzhou inspector, marching to Xia mouth; the western court debated who should run the province; Tan said, "Xiang country is quick to stir and slow to trust.
units.literal: At the time supporting-the-state general Yang Gongze was inspector of Xiangzhou and led troops to Xia mouth; the western court debated who should act as inspector; Tan told the assembly: "The temper of Xiang country is easy to stir and hard to trust.

units.zh: 若專用武士，則百姓畏侵漁；
units.en: Send only warriors and the people fear plunder;
units.literal: If you rely on warriors alone, the people will fear plunder;

units.zh: 若遣文人，則威略不振。
units.en: send only men of letters and authority will not hold.
units.literal: if you send men of letters alone, authority and strategy will not hold.

units.zh: 必欲鎮靜一州城，軍民足食，則無逾老臣。
units.en: To quiet the province and feed army and people, none surpasses this old servant.
units.literal: If you truly wish to quiet a whole province, feed army and people alike, none surpasses this old servant.

units.zh: 先零之役，竊以自許。」
units.en: In the Xianlian campaign—I dare answer for that."
units.literal: In the campaign against the Xianlian—I dare claim that for myself."

units.zh: 遂從之。
units.en: They took his counsel.
units.literal: They followed his counsel.

units.zh: 乃除輔國長史、長沙太守，行湘州事。
units.en: He was made supporting-the-state chief of staff, Changsha grand administrator, and acting Xiangzhou inspector.
units.literal: He was made chief of staff to the supporting-the-state army, grand administrator of Changsha, and acting inspector of Xiangzhou.

units.zh: 坦嘗在湘州，多舊恩，道迎者甚衆。
units.en: He had served in Xiang before and held many ties; crowds met him on the road.
units.literal: Tan had once served in Xiangzhou and had many old ties; a great crowd came to meet him on the road.

units.zh: 下車簡選堪事吏，分詣十郡，悉發人丁，運租米三十餘萬斛，致之義師，資糧用給。
units.en: He chose able clerks for ten commanderies, mustered labor, and forwarded three hundred thousand hu of tax grain to the Righteous Army.
units.literal: On taking office he chose able clerks and sent them to the ten commanderies, mustered laborers everywhere, and moved more than three hundred thousand hu of tax grain to the Righteous Army so supplies held.

units.zh: 時東昏遣安成太守劉希祖破西臺所選太守范僧簡於平都，希祖移檄湘部，於是始興內史王僧粲應之。
units.en: Donghun's Liu Xizu defeated the western court's Fan Senjian at Pingdu and issued a call across Xiang; Shixing interior governor Wang Sengru answered.
units.literal: At the time Donghun sent Ancheng grand administrator Liu Xizu to defeat the western court's chosen grand administrator Fan Senjian at Pingdu; Xizu issued a proclamation across Xiang, and then Shixing interior governor Wang Sengru answered him.

units.zh: 邵陵人逐其內史褚洊，永陽人周暉起兵攻始安郡，並應僧粲。
units.en: Shaoling drove out Chu Zhan; Yongyang's Zhou Hui attacked Shian—all joined Sengru.
units.literal: Shaoling men drove out their interior governor Chu Zhan; Yongyang men Zhou Hui raised troops and attacked Shian commandery—all answered Sengru.

units.zh: 桂陽人邵曇弄、鄧道介報復私仇，因合黨亦同焉。
units.en: Guiyang's Shao Tanlong and Deng Daojie, settling private scores, joined as well.
units.literal: Guiyang men Shao Tanlong and Deng Daojie, settling private scores, also joined the league.

units.zh: 僧粲自號平西將軍、湘州刺史，以永陽人周舒爲謀主，師于建寧。
units.en: Sengru called himself pacifying-the-west general and Xiangzhou inspector, set Zhou Shu of Yongyang as strategist, and camped at Jianning.
units.literal: Sengru styled himself pacifying-the-west general and inspector of Xiangzhou, made Yongyang man Zhou Shu his strategist, and camped at Jianning.

units.zh: 自是湘部諸郡，悉皆蜂起；
units.en: Then every Xiang commandery rose;
units.literal: From then on commanderies across Xiang rose like hornets;

units.zh: 惟臨湘、湘陰、瀏陽、羅四縣猶全。
units.en: only Linxiang, Xiangyin, Liuyang, and Luo still stood intact.
units.literal: only Linxiang, Xiangyin, Liuyang, and Luo four counties still held whole.

units.zh: 州人咸欲泛舟逃走，坦悉聚船焚之，遣將尹法略距僧粲，相持未決。
units.en: The province meant to flee by boat; Tan burned the fleet, sent Yin Falüe against Sengru, and stalemate followed.
units.literal: The people of the province all wished to flee by boat; Tan gathered every vessel and burned them, sent the general Yin Falüe to hold off Sengru, and the two sides locked in stalemate.

units.zh: 前湘州鎮軍鐘玄紹潛謀應僧粲，要結士庶數百人，皆連名定計，刻日反州城。
units.en: Former garrison commander Zhong Xuanshao plotted for Sengru, binding hundreds of gentry to rise on a set day.
units.literal: Former Xiangzhou garrison commander Zhong Xuanshao secretly plotted to join Sengru, mustering several hundred gentry and commoners by linked names to a fixed day for a rising in the provincial city.

units.zh: 坦聞其謀，偽爲不知，因理訟至夜，而城門遂不閉，以疑之。
units.en: Tan heard but played ignorant, heard suits till night, and left the gates open to breed doubt.
units.literal: Tan heard the plot but feigned ignorance, heard lawsuits into the night, and left the gates unclosed to sow doubt.

units.zh: 玄紹未及發，明旦詣坦問其故。
units.en: Before Xuanshao moved, at dawn he came to ask why.
units.literal: Xuanshao had not yet moved; at dawn he came to Tan to ask why.

units.zh: 坦久留與語，密遣親兵收其家書。
units.en: Tan detained him in talk and sent soldiers to seize his papers.
units.literal: Tan kept him long in talk and secretly sent trusted soldiers to seize his household papers.

units.zh: 玄紹在坐未起，而收兵已報具得其文書本末，玄紹卽首伏，於坐斬之。
units.en: Still seated, Xuanshao learned the papers were taken; he confessed and was beheaded on the spot.
units.literal: Xuanshao had not yet risen from his seat when the soldiers reported they had the documents entire; Xuanshao confessed at once and was beheaded where he sat.

units.zh: 焚其文書，其餘黨悉無所問，衆愧且服，州部遂安。
units.en: The papers burned; the rest went untouched; shame and submission followed, and the province calmed.
units.literal: The papers were burned; the rest of the party were not questioned; the crowd felt shame and yielded, and the province was quiet.

units.zh: 法略與僧粲相持累月，建康城平，公則還州，羣賊始散。
units.en: Falüe and Sengru fought for months; Jiankang fell, Gongze returned, and the rebels scattered.
units.literal: Falüe and Sengru locked horns for months; when Jiankang fell, Gongze returned to the province and the rebels at last scattered.

units.zh: 天監初，論功封荔浦縣子，邑三百戶。
units.en: At Tianjian's opening he was baron of Lipu with three hundred households.
units.literal: At the start of Tianjian, for merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Lipu with three hundred households.

units.zh: 遷平西司馬、新興太守。
units.en: He became western army marshal and Xinxing grand administrator.
units.literal: He was promoted to western army marshal and grand administrator of Xinxing.

units.zh: 天監三年，遷西中郎長史，卒，時年六十二。
units.en: In Tianjian year three he was western army chief of staff and died at sixty-two.
units.literal: In Tianjian year three he was promoted western army chief of staff and died, aged sixty-two.

units.zh: 子泉嗣。
units.en: His son Quan succeeded.
units.literal: His son Quan succeeded.

units.zh: 樂藹字蔚遠，南陽淯陽人，晉尚書令廣之六世孫，世居江陵。
units.en: Yue Ai, styled Weiyuan, came from Yuyang in Nanyang, sixth from Jin's Director Guang; his line lived in Jiangling.
units.literal: Yue Ai, styled Weiyuan, was a native of Yuyang in Nanyang, sixth-generation descendant of Jin's Director of the Masters of Writing Guang, his family long in Jiangling.

units.zh: 其舅雍州刺史宗愨，嘗陳器物，試諸甥侄。
units.en: His uncle Zong Que, Yongzhou inspector, once set out vessels to test his nephews.
units.literal: His uncle, Yongzhou inspector Zong Que, once set out vessels and tested his nephews.

units.zh: 藹時尚幼，而所取惟書，愨由此奇之。
units.en: Ai was young but chose only books; Que marveled.
units.literal: Ai was still young but took only books; Que marveled at that.

units.zh: 又取史傳各一卷授藹等，使讀畢，言所記。
units.en: He gave each a history scroll, had them read, then recite from memory.
units.literal: He also gave each a scroll of histories and had them read and recite what they remembered.

units.zh: 藹略讀具舉，愨益善之。
units.en: Ai skimmed and named every point; Que prized him more.
units.literal: Ai skimmed and named every point; Que prized him still more.

units.zh: 宋建平王景素爲荊州刺史，辟爲主簿。
units.en: Song's Prince of Jianping, inspector of Jingzhou, made him chief clerk.
units.literal: Song's Prince of Jianping Jingsu was inspector of Jingzhou and summoned him as chief clerk.

units.zh: 景素爲南徐州，復爲征北刑獄參軍，遷龍陽相。
units.en: When Jingsu held southern Xuzhou, Ai served on the northern punitive staff, then became Longyang magistrate.
units.literal: When Jingsu held southern Xuzhou, Ai again served as staff officer on the northern punitive staff, then was promoted magistrate of Longyang.

units.zh: 以父憂去職，吏民詣州請之，葬訖起焉。
units.en: His father's mourning took him away; officials and people begged the province to recall him, and after burial he returned.
units.literal: He left office for his father's mourning; officials and people went to the province to ask him back, and after the burial he took up the post again.

units.zh: 時齊豫章王嶷爲武陵太守，雅善藹爲政，及嶷爲荊州刺史，以藹爲驃騎行參軍、領州主簿，參知州事。
units.en: Qi's Prince of Yuzhang Yi, Wuling grand administrator, prized his rule; when Yi became Jingzhou inspector, he made Ai a staff officer and head clerk, sharing provincial affairs.
units.literal: At the time Qi's Prince of Yuzhang Yi was grand administrator of Wuling and greatly prized Ai's governance; when Yi became Jingzhou inspector, he made Ai staff officer on the chief of staff's staff and head clerk of the province, sharing in provincial affairs.

units.zh: 嶷嘗問藹風土舊俗，城隍基啉寺，山川險易，藹隨問立對，若按圖牒，嶷益重焉。
units.en: Yi asked about custom, walls, temples, and passes; Ai answered as from a map, and Yi esteemed him more.
units.literal: Yi once asked him about local custom, old ways, city walls and foundations, temples, and mountain passes—Ai answered each question on the spot as if reading from a gazetteer, and Yi esteemed him the more.

units.zh: 州人嫉之，或譖藹廨門如市，嶷遣覘之，方見藹閉閣讀書。
units.en: Envious men said his gate was a market; Yi watched and found him reading behind closed doors.
units.literal: Provincial men envied him; some slandered him, saying his office gate was like a market; Yi sent men to watch and found Ai behind closed doors reading.

units.zh: 嶷還都，以藹爲太尉刑獄參軍，典書記，遷枝江令。
units.en: Yi returned to court; Ai became Grand Marshal punitive staff officer, ran the secretariat, then Zhijiang magistrate.
units.literal: When Yi returned to the capital, Ai was made staff officer on the Grand Marshal's punitive staff, in charge of the secretariat, then magistrate of Zhijiang.

units.zh: 還爲大司馬中兵參軍，轉署記室。
units.en: He returned as Grand Marshal middle army officer, then acting recorder.
units.literal: On return he was middle army staff officer to the Grand Marshal, then acting recorder.

units.zh: 永明八年，荊州刺史巴東王子響稱兵反，旣敗，焚燒府舍，官曹文書，一時蕩盡。
units.en: In Yongming year eight Prince Zixiang of Badong rebelled; defeated, he burned the offices and every record was lost.
units.literal: In Yongming year eight the Prince of Badong Zixiang raised troops in rebellion; when he was defeated he burned the government offices and every document in the bureaus was lost at once.

units.zh: 武帝引見藹，問以西事，藹上對詳敏，帝悅焉。
units.en: The Emperor summoned him, asked about the west; his answers pleased the throne.
units.literal: The Emperor summoned Ai and asked about western affairs; Ai answered in full detail and the Emperor was pleased.

units.zh: 用爲荊州治中，敕付以修復府州事。
units.en: He was made Jingzhou chief clerk and ordered to rebuild the seat.
units.literal: He was made Jingzhou chief clerk with orders to restore the provincial seat.

units.zh: 藹還州，繕脩廨署數百區，頃之咸畢，而役不及民。
units.en: Back in the province he rebuilt hundreds of offices at once without burdening the people.
units.literal: Ai returned to the province, repaired several hundred office compounds, and soon all were done while the labor did not burden the people.

units.zh: 荊部以爲自晉王悅移鎮以來，府舍未之有也。
units.en: Jing said that since Jin's Wang Yue moved the seat, no seat had matched it.
units.literal: Jing region said that since Jin's Wang Yue moved his seat, no government house had matched it.

units.zh: 九年，豫章王嶷薨，藹解官赴喪，率荊、湘二州故吏，建碑墓所。
units.en: In year nine Prince Yi died; Ai mourned, led old Jing and Xiang clerks, and raised a tomb stele.
units.literal: In year nine the Prince of Yuzhang Yi died; Ai left office to mourn, led former clerks of Jing and Xiang, and set a stele at the tomb.

units.zh: 累遷車騎平西錄事參軍、步兵校尉，求助戍西歸。
units.en: He rose to chariot-and-cavalry western recorder and infantry commandant, then begged leave to guard the west.
units.literal: Through offices he rose to recorder on the chariot-and-cavalry pacifying-the-west staff and infantry commandant, and begged leave to guard the west on his return.

units.zh: 南康王爲西中郎，以藹爲諮議參軍。
units.en: When the Prince of Nankang commanded the western army, Ai was staff adviser.
units.literal: When the Prince of Nankang was western army commander, Ai was his staff adviser.

units.zh: 義師起，蕭穎胄引藹及宗夬、劉坦，任以經略。
units.en: When the Righteous Army rose, Xiao Yingzhou brought in Ai, Zong Guai, and Liu Tan for strategy.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army rose, Xiao Yingzhou brought in Ai with Zong Guai and Liu Tan and entrusted them with strategy.

units.zh: 梁台建，遷鎮軍司馬、中書侍郎、尚書左丞。
units.en: When the Liang headquarters was founded, he became guarding-the-state marshal, Secretariat gentleman, and Left Director.
units.literal: When the Liang headquarters was founded, he was promoted to marshal of the army that guards the state, palace gentleman of the Secretariat, and Left Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 時營造器甲，舟艦軍糧，及朝廷儀憲，悉資藹焉。
units.en: Forging arms, building ships, army grain, and court ritual all ran through Ai.
units.literal: At the time forging arms and armor, warships and army grain, and court ritual all drew on Ai.

units.zh: 尋遷給事黃門侍郎，左丞如故。
units.en: Soon he was Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, Left Director unchanged.
units.literal: Soon he was promoted to Gentleman of the Yellow Gate who attends to matters, Left Director as before.

units.zh: 和帝東下，道兼衛尉卿。
units.en: When Emperor He went east, Ai served as Commandant of the Guard on the road.
units.literal: When Emperor He went east, Ai held the post of Commandant of the Guard on the road.

units.zh: 天監初，遷驍騎將軍、領少府卿；
units.en: At Tianjian's opening he was Raiding Cavalry General and palace workshop director;
units.literal: At the start of Tianjian he was promoted to Raiding Cavalry General and Director of the Palace Workshop;

units.zh: 俄遷御史中丞，領本州大中正。
units.en: soon Censor-in-Chief and head of his province's great rectifiers.
units.literal: soon he was Censor-in-Chief and head of the great rectifiers of his native province.

units.zh: 初，藹發江陵，無故於船得八車輻，如中丞健步避道者，至是果遷焉。
units.en: Leaving Jiangling he had found eight carriage hubs on the boat, like a censor stepping aside—and now the omen held.
units.literal: When Ai had set out from Jiangling he found for no reason on the boat eight carriage hubs, like a censor's brisk step giving way on the road—and now the omen came true.

units.zh: 藹性公強，居憲臺甚稱職。
units.en: Fair and forceful, he shone at the censorate.
units.literal: Ai's nature was fair and forceful; at the censorate he filled the post admirably.

units.zh: 時長沙宣武王將葬，而車府忽於庫火油絡，欲推主者。
units.en: King Xuanwu of Changsha was to be buried when the carriage office found lamp oil burning in the storehouse and sought a culprit.
units.literal: At the time King Xuanwu of Changsha was to be buried, and the carriage office suddenly found lamp oil ablaze in the storehouse; they wished to impeach the keeper.

units.zh: 藹曰：「昔晉武庫火，張華以爲積油萬石必然。
units.en: Ai said, "When Jin's arsenal burned, Zhang Hua said ten thousand stone of piled oil made fire inevitable.
units.literal: Ai said: "In Jin, when the arsenal caught fire, Zhang Hua held that ten thousand stone of oil piled up made it inevitable.

units.zh: 今庫若有灰，非吏罪也。」
units.en: If ash lies in the storehouse, no clerk is to blame."
units.literal: If the storehouse now holds ash, it is no clerk's crime."

units.zh: 旣而檢之，果有積灰。
units.en: Inspection found piled ash.
units.literal: On inspection there was indeed piled ash.

units.zh: 時稱其博物弘恕焉。
units.en: The age praised his learning and his large forgiveness.
units.literal: The age praised his broad learning and large forgiveness.

units.zh: 二年，出爲持節、督廣交越三州諸軍、冠軍將軍、平越中郎將、廣州刺史。
units.en: In year two he went out with staff, commanding Guang, Jiao, and Yue, champion general, pacifying-the-Yue commander, and Guangzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year two he went out bearer of staff, commander of military affairs in Guang, Jiao, and Yue, Champion General, pacifying-the-Yue middle army commander, and inspector of Guangzhou.

units.zh: 前刺史徐元瑜罷歸，道遇始興人士反，逐內史崔睦舒，因掠元瑜財產。
units.en: Former inspector Xu Yuanyu met Shixing rebels on the road; they drove out Cui Mushu and looted his goods.
units.literal: The former inspector Xu Yuanyu left his post and on the road met Shixing men in revolt; they drove out interior governor Cui Mushu and plundered Yuanyu's goods.

units.zh: 元瑜走歸廣州，借兵於藹，托欲討賊，而實謀襲藹。
units.en: Yuanyu fled to Guangzhou, borrowed troops to hunt bandits, but meant to strike Ai.
units.literal: Yuanyu fled back to Guangzhou, borrowed troops from Ai on the pretext of punishing bandits, but in truth meant to strike Ai.

units.zh: 藹覺之，誅元瑜。
units.en: Ai saw through it and killed Yuanyu.
units.literal: Ai saw through it and executed Yuanyu.

units.zh: 尋進號征虜將軍，卒官。
units.en: Soon he was general who campaigns against barbarians and died in office.
units.literal: Soon his title advanced to general who campaigns against barbarians; he died in office.

units.zh: 藹姊適徵士同郡劉虯，亦明識有禮訓。
units.en: His elder sister married the recluse Liu Jiao of his commandery, famed for discernment and ritual.
units.literal: Ai's elder sister married the reclusive Liu Jiao of the same commandery, also famed for discernment and ritual teaching.

units.zh: 藹爲州，迎姊居官舍，參分祿秩，西土稱之。
units.en: As inspector he brought his sister to the yamen and shared salary; the west praised it.
units.literal: When Ai was in the province he welcomed his sister to the official residence and shared his salary; the west praised it.

units.zh: 子法才，字元備，幼與弟法藏俱有美名。
units.en: His son Facai, styled Yuanbei, and his brother Fazang were both famed in youth.
units.literal: His son Facai, styled Yuanbei, in youth with his younger brother Fazang both had a fine name.

units.zh: 少游京師，造沈約，約見而稱之。
units.en: In youth he visited Shen Yue at the capital; Yue praised him.
units.literal: Young, he traveled to the capital and visited Shen Yue; Yue saw him and praised him.

units.zh: 齊和帝爲相國，召爲府參軍，鎮軍蕭穎胄辟主簿。
units.en: When Emperor He of Qi was prime minister, Facai joined his staff; Xiao Yingzhou made him chief clerk.
units.literal: When Qi's Emperor He was prime minister, Facai was summoned as staff officer to the prime minister's office; the army that guards the state, Xiao Yingzhou, made him chief clerk.

units.zh: 梁臺建，除起部郎。
units.en: When the Liang headquarters was founded, he was Gentleman who initiates affairs.
units.literal: When the Liang headquarters was founded, he was made Gentleman who initiates affairs.

units.zh: 天監二年，藹出鎮嶺表，法才留任京邑，遷金部郎，父憂去官。
units.en: In Tianjian year two Ai went south; Facai stayed at court as Director of the Treasury, then mourned his father.
units.literal: In Tianjian year two, when Ai went out to command the southern frontier, Facai stayed in the capital, was promoted to Director of the Treasury, and left office for his father's mourning.

units.zh: 服闋，除中書通事舍人，出爲本州別駕。
units.en: After mourning he handled Secretariat affairs and went out as native province chief clerk.
units.literal: When mourning ended he was made Secretariat attendant who handles affairs and went out as chief clerk of his native province.

units.zh: 入爲通直散騎侍郎，復掌通事，遷尚書右丞。
units.en: He entered as Regular Attendant, again handled affairs, then became Right Director.
units.literal: He entered as Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, again handled affairs, and was promoted Right Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 晉安王爲荊州，重除別駕從事史。
units.en: When the Prince of Jin'an held Jingzhou, he was again chief clerk and staff officer.
units.literal: When the Prince of Jin'an held Jingzhou, he was again made chief clerk and staff officer.

units.zh: 復徵爲尚書右丞，出爲招遠將軍、建康令。
units.en: Recalled as Right Director, he went out as general who invites from afar and Jiankang magistrate.
units.literal: He was summoned again as Right Director, went out as general who invites from afar and magistrate of Jiankang.

units.zh: 不受俸秩，比去任，將至百金，縣曹啟輸臺庫。
units.en: He took no salary; near a hundred jin of gold had gathered when he left, and the county reported it to the central treasury.
units.literal: He would not take salary; by the time he left office he had nearly a hundred jin of gold, and the county clerks reported it to the central treasury.

units.zh: 高祖嘉其清節，曰：「居職若斯，可以爲百城表矣。」
units.en: Gaozu prized his integrity and said, "To hold office like this is to be a model for a hundred cities.”
units.literal: Gaozu prized his integrity and said: "To hold office like this is to stand as a model for a hundred cities.”

units.zh: 卽日遷太府卿。
units.en: That same day he was made grand chamberlain.
units.literal: That same day he was transferred to Grand Chamberlain.

units.zh: 尋除南康內史，恥以讓俸受名，辭不拜。
units.en: Soon named Nankang interior administrator, he refused the post rather than accept a title earned by yielding his salary.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed interior administrator of Nankang; ashamed to accept the name of one who yielded his salary, he declined and did not take the post.

units.zh: 俄轉雲騎將軍、少府卿。
units.en: Before long he became cloud-cavalry general and minister of palace supplies.
units.literal: Before long he was transferred to Cloud-Cavalry General and Minister of Palace Supplies.

units.zh: 出爲信武長史、江夏太守。
units.en: He went out as Trustworthy Martial chief clerk and Jiangxia administrator.
units.literal: He went out as chief clerk on the Trustworthy Martial staff and Jiangxia administrator.

units.zh: 因被代，表便道還鄉。
units.en: Replaced in office, he asked leave to go home by the direct route.
units.literal: When he was replaced, he memorialized to return home by the direct route.

units.zh: 至家，割宅爲寺，棲心物表。
units.en: At home he gave part of his house for a temple and turned his mind from the world.
units.literal: At home he divided his residence to make a temple and lodged his heart beyond worldly affairs.

units.zh: 皇太子以法才舊臣，累有優令，召使東下，未及發而卒，時年六十三。
units.en: The crown prince, holding Facai an old servant, sent him generous summons east again and again; he died before he could leave, at sixty-three.
units.literal: The crown prince, since Facai was an old retainer, repeatedly sent favorable orders summoning him east; before he could set out he died, aged sixty-three.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：蕭穎胄起大州之衆以會義，當其時，人心未之能悟。
units.en: Chen minister of personnel Yao Cha said: Xiao Yingzhou gathered a great province’s forces for the founding cause; then few yet saw what was coming.
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Xiao Yingzhou raised the hosts of a great province to join the righteous cause; at that time men’s hearts had not yet understood.

units.zh: 此三人者，楚之鎮也。
units.en: These three were Chu’s pillars.
units.literal: These three were Chu’s anchor.

units.zh: 經營締構，蓋有力焉。
units.en: In planning and laying the foundations they surely did heavy work.
units.literal: In planning and building the foundation they surely had force.

units.zh: 方面之功，坦爲多矣；
units.en: On the frontier Tan did the heavier part;
units.literal: In regional achievements Tan had the greater share;

units.zh: 當官任事，藹則兼之。
units.en: in office and in duty Ai had both.
units.literal: in holding office and managing affairs Ai had both.

units.zh: 咸登寵秩，宜乎！
units.en: All rose to favored rank—as they should!
units.literal: All ascended to favored rank—fitting!

units.zh: 宋昇明中，孫曇瓘謀反亡命，褚謂其子僧簡曰：「孫越州先姑之姉子，與汝父親則從母兄弟，交則義重古人。
units.en: During the Shengming era Sun Tanwan rebelled and fled. Chu told her son Sengjian: "Sun of Yuezhou is kin to your late aunt; he and your father are cousins, and their friendship was as weighty as that of the ancients.
units.literal: During the Shengming era of Song, Sun Tanwan rebelled and fled as an outlaw; Chu said to her son Sengjian: "Sun of Yuezhou is the elder sister's son of your late aunt; with your father he is a cousin on the mother's side, and in friendship their bond weighed as heavily as that of men of old.

units.zh: 曇瓘尋伏法，褚氏令僧簡往歛葬。
units.en: Tanwan was soon executed. Lady Chu sent Sengjian to recover his body and bury him.
units.literal: Before long Tanwan was executed by law; Lady Chu had Sengjian go to gather and bury him.

units.zh: 僧簡在都，聞病馳歸，未至而褚已卒，將殯，舉尸不起，尋而僧簡至焉。
units.en: Sengjian was in the capital. Hearing she was ill he rushed home, but she died before he arrived. When they tried to move her body for burial it would not lift—until Sengjian came.
units.literal: Sengjian was in the capital; hearing she was ill, he raced home, but before he arrived Chu had already died. When they were about to encoffin her, the corpse could not be lifted—then Sengjian arrived.

units.zh: 時明帝謀入嗣位，朝之舊臣皆引參謀策。
units.en: Mingdi was then plotting to enter the succession; old courtiers were all drawn into counsel.
units.literal: Mingdi was then plotting succession to the throne; old ministers of the court were all drawn into counsel.

units.zh: 明帝下詔曰：「夫超然榮觀，風流自遠；
units.en: Mingdi issued an edict: "To stand beyond glory is to see the world from far off;
units.literal: Mingdi issued an edict: "One who stands apart from glory views the world from afar;

units.zh: 初，齊明帝及覽父綍、東海徐孝嗣，並爲吳興，號稱名守，覽皆欲過之！
units.en: Once Qi Mingdi, Lan's father Fu, and Donghai's Xu Xiaosi had all ruled Wuxing as famed administrators—Lan meant to outdo them all!
units.literal: Earlier Qi Mingdi, Lan's father Fu, and Xu Xiaosi of Donghai had all governed Wuxing and been called famed administrators—Lan wished to surpass them all!

units.zh: 建武四年，詔徵爲侍中、中書令，遂抗表不應召。
units.en: In Jianwu's fourth year an edict summoned him as attendant-in-ordinary and palace secretariat director; he memorialized and refused.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwu an edict summoned him as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Palace Secretariat Director; he submitted a memorial refusing the summons.

units.zh: 蹈彼幽人，英華罕值。
units.en: to walk the hermit's way is to bloom in solitude.
units.literal: one who treads the hermit's path is rarely met in full flower.

units.zh: 故長揖楚相，見稱南國；
units.en: hence the long bow of the Chu minister won praise in the southern states;
units.literal: Hence the long bow to the Chu minister won praise in the southern states;

units.zh: 高謝漢臣，取貴良史。
units.en: the Han worthy's lofty refusal won honor from fine historians.
units.literal: the Han worthy's high refusal won honor from fine historians.

units.zh: 新除侍中、中書令朏，早藉羽儀，夙標清尚，登朝樹績，出守馳聲。
units.en: The newly appointed attendant-in-ordinary and palace secretariat director Fei long wore court insignia and from youth bore a clear name; in court he built merit, abroad he made his name heard.
units.literal: The newly appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary and Palace Secretariat Director Fei long bore the court insignia and from youth bore a pure reputation; in court he built merit, going out he made his name heard.

units.zh: 遂斂跡康衢，拂衣林沚，抱箕潁之餘芳，甘憔悴而無悶。
units.en: Then he gathered his steps from the broad highway and shook dust from forest robes, keeping the after-scent of Jiqian and Ying, glad in lean exile without regret.
units.literal: Then he gathered his steps from the broad highway and shook the dust from his forest robes, embracing the lingering fragrance of Jiqian and Ying, content in lean exile without regret.

units.zh: 撫事懷人，載留欽想。
units.en: Hearing his story, one keeps him in honored thought.
units.literal: Hearing of his deeds one keeps him in honored thought.

units.zh: 宜加優禮，用旌素概。
units.en: Let added courtesy mark his plain integrity.
units.literal: He should receive added courtesy to mark his plain integrity.

units.zh: 可賜床帳褥席，俸以卿祿，常出在所。」
units.en: Grant bed curtains and padded mats, salary at minister rank, always sent to his dwelling."
units.literal: Grant bed curtains and padded mats, salary at minister rank, always provided at his dwelling."

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 立皇子嶷爲豫章王，映爲臨川王，晃爲長沙王，曅爲武陵王，暠爲安成王，鏘爲鄱陽王，鑠爲桂陽王，鑒爲廣陵王，皇孫長懋爲南郡王。
units.en: Princes were named: Yi of Yuzhang, Ying of Linchuan, Huang of Changsha, Ye of Wuling, Gao of Ancheng, Qiang of Poyang, Shuo of Guiyang, Jian of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao became prince of Nan commandery.
units.literal: The princes Luan was made Prince of Yuzhang; Ying Prince of Linchuan; Huang Prince of Changsha; Ye Prince of Wuling; Gao Prince of Ancheng; Qiang Prince of Poyang; Shuo Prince of Guiyang; Jian Prince of Guangling; the imperial grandson Zhangmao Prince of Nan.

units.zh: 以後將軍長沙王晃爲護軍將軍，中軍將軍南郡王長懋爲南徐州刺史，冠軍將軍安成王暠爲江州刺史。
units.en: Prince of Changsha Xiao Huang, rear general, became protector of the army; Prince of Nan Commandery Xiao Zhangmao, general of the center, took South Xuzhou; Prince of Ancheng Xiao Gao, champion general, took Jiang.
units.literal: Rear General, Prince of Changsha Xiao Huang was made Protector of the Army; General of the Center, Prince of Nan Commandery Xiao Changmao was made Inspector of South Xuzhou; Champion General, Prince of Ancheng Xiao Hao was made Inspector of Jiang.

units.zh: 八歲，讀沈約集，見回文研銘，從典援筆擬之，便有佳致。
units.en: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works. Seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush to match it and at once produced something fine.
units.literal: At eight he read Shen Yue's collected works; seeing a palindrome study inscription, Congdian took up the brush and imitated it, and at once achieved fine effect.

units.zh: 戊戌，以荊州刺史嶷爲尚書令、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、揚州刺史，冠軍將軍映爲荊州刺史，西中郎將晃爲南徐州刺史，冠軍將軍垣崇祖爲豫州刺史，驃騎司馬崔文仲爲徐州刺史。
units.en: Day wuxu: Yi, inspector of Jing, became director of the master of writing, general-in-chief who spreads might, with secretariat equal to the three excellencies, and inspector of Yang; Ying, champion general, inspector of Jing; Huang, west general of the gentlemen, inspector of South Xuzhou; Yuan Chongzu, champion general, inspector of Yu; Cui Wenzong, chief commandant under the general who spreads might, inspector of Xu.
units.literal: On day wuxu, Inspector of Jing Province Luan was made Director of the Master of Writing, General-in-Chief Who Spreads Might, with Grand Secretariat and staff equal to the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Yang Province; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Ying was made Inspector of Jing Province; West General of the Gentlemen Huang was made Inspector of South Xuzhou; General Who Vanquishes the Foe Yuan Chongzu was made Inspector of Yu Province; Chief Commandant of the General Who Spreads Might Cui Wenzong was made Inspector of Xu Province.

units.zh: 乙巳，以新除尚書令、驃騎將軍豫章王嶷爲荊、湘二州刺史，平西將軍臨川王映爲揚州刺史。
units.en: Day yisi: Yi, new director of the master of writing and general who spreads might, prince of Yuzhang, took Jing and Xiang; Ying, prince of Linchuan and general who pacifies the west, took Yang.
units.literal: On day yisi the newly appointed Director of the Master of Writing, General-in-Chief Who Spreads Might, Prince of Yuzhang Luan was made Inspector of Jing and Xiang; General Who Pacifies the West, Prince of Linchuan Ying was made Inspector of Yang.

units.zh: 壬子，以驃騎大將軍豫章王嶷爲司空，揚州刺史、前將軍臨川王映爲荊州刺史。
units.en: On day renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Yi, general of agile cavalry, became minister of works; Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying, forward general and inspector of Yangzhou, took Jing.
units.literal: On day renzi, General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Yuzhang Xiao Luan was made Minister of Works; Inspector of Yangzhou, Forward General, Prince of Linchuan Xiao Ying was made Inspector of Jing.

units.zh: 以失儀出爲南郡王中軍司馬。
units.en: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor to the Prince of Nanjun.
units.literal: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor of the Prince of Nanjun.

units.zh: 祖靈運，宋臨川內史。
units.en: His grandfather Lingyun had been Song governor of Linchuan.
units.literal: His grandfather Lingyun was Song grand administrator of Linchuan.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 遙光敗，入東昏宮。
units.en: When Yaoguang fell, she was taken into the Depraved Emperor's palace.
units.literal: When Yaoguang was defeated, she entered the Depraved Emperor's palace.

units.zh: 宋建平王景素好士，淹隨景素在南兗州。
units.en: Jingsu, Prince of Jianping under Song, prized men of letters; Yan served him in Southern Yanzhou.
units.literal: Jingsu, Prince of Jianping under Song, loved scholars; Yan followed Jingsu in Southern Yanzhou.

units.zh: 景素覽書，卽日出之。
units.en: Jingsu read the letter and freed him the same day.
units.literal: Jingsu read the memorial and released him that same day.

units.zh: 景素爲荊州，淹從之鎮。
units.en: When Jingsu took Jing province, Yan went with him to the command.
units.literal: When Jingsu went to Jing province, Yan followed him to the post.

units.zh: 景素專據上流，咸勸因此舉事。
units.en: Jingsu held the upper river country alone; many urged him to strike while he could.
units.literal: Jingsu held the upper reaches exclusively; many urged him to raise arms on that account.

units.zh: 景素不納。
units.en: Jingsu would not listen.
units.literal: Jingsu did not accept his advice.

units.zh: 景素與腹心日夜謀議，淹知禍機將發，乃贈詩十五首以諷焉。
units.en: Jingsu and his inner circle schemed night and day; Yan saw disaster near and offered fifteen poems as warning.
units.literal: Jingsu and his intimates plotted day and night; Yan saw ruin coming and sent fifteen poems as indirect warning.

units.zh: 會南東海太守陸澄丁艱，淹自謂郡丞應行郡事，景素用司馬柳世隆。
units.en: When Southern Donghai prefect Lu Cheng began mourning, Yan assumed the aide should run the commandery; Jingsu gave the post to staff officer Liu Shilong.
units.literal: When Southern Donghai prefect Lu Cheng entered mourning for his father, Yan thought that as commandery aide he should act as prefect; Jingsu appointed staff officer Liu Shilong instead.

units.zh: 淹固求之，景素大怒，言於選部，黜爲建安吳興令。
units.en: Yan insisted; Jingsu raged, spoke to personnel, and demoted him to Jian'an magistrate in Wu-xing.
units.literal: Yan pressed his claim; Jingsu was furious and spoke to the selection office, demoting him to magistrate of Jian'an in Wu-xing.

units.zh: 太宗簡文皇帝諱綱，字世纘，小字六通，高祖第三子，昭明太子母弟也。
units.en: Taizong Emperor Jianwen, personal name Gang, courtesy name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong, was Gaozu's third son and Zhaoming Crown Prince's younger brother by the same mother.
units.literal: The Taizong Emperor Jianwen was tabooed Gang, style name Shizuan, childhood name Liutong; he was the third son of the Gaozu and a uterine younger brother of Crown Prince Zhaoming.

units.zh: 初，太宗見幽縶，題壁自序云：「有梁正士蘭陵蕭世纘，立身行道，終始如一，風雨如晦，雞鳴不已。
units.en: At first, when Taizong was held captive, he wrote on the wall: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, one in conduct from start to finish—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.
units.literal: At first, when Taizong was imprisoned, he wrote a self-account on the wall, saying: "I, Xiao Shizuan of Lanling, upright man of Liang, in conduct from first to last one—though wind and rain darken the sky, the cock crows without cease.

units.zh: 晉安王綱，文義生知，孝敬自然，威惠外宣，德行內敏，羣后歸美，率土宅心。
units.en: Prince Gang of Jin'an was gifted in letters and principles, naturally filial and respectful, his authority and kindness known abroad and his virtue keen within; the lords praised him and the realm took him to heart.
units.literal: Prince of Jin'an Gang, gifted in letters and right by nature, filial and respectful by instinct, his authority and kindness proclaimed abroad and virtue and conduct keen within, the feudal lords admired him and all the land took him to heart.

units.zh: 明年，三月己丑，王僧辯率前百官奉梓宮升朝堂，世祖追崇為簡文皇帝，廟曰太宗。
units.en: The next year, on jichou in the third month, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials to raise the coffin to the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen with temple name Taizong.
units.literal: The next year, third month, day jichou, Wang Senbian led the former hundred officials in escorting the coffin up the audience hall; Shizu posthumously honored him as Emperor Jianwen, with temple name Taizong.

units.zh: 五年，封晉安王，食邑八千戶。
units.en: In year 5 he was made Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.
units.literal: In year 5 he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jin'an with a fief of eight thousand households.

units.zh: 戊午，侯景遣衛尉卿彭俊、廂公王僧貴率兵入殿，廢太宗為晉安王，幽于永福省。
units.en: On wuwu day Hou Jing sent minister of the guard Peng Jun and palace section commander Wang Senggui with troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and imprisoned him in Yongfu Palace.
units.literal: On wuwu, Hou Jing sent Minister of the Guard Peng Jun and Palace Section Commander Wang Senggui to lead troops into the hall, deposed Taizong as Prince of Jin'an, and confined him in Yongfu Palace.

units.zh: 可立為皇太子。」
units.en: He is to be established as crown prince."
units.literal: He may be established as crown prince."

units.zh: 賊偽諡曰明皇帝，廟稱高宗。
units.en: The rebels gave him the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.
units.literal: The rebels gave the posthumous title Bright Emperor and the temple name Gaozong.

units.zh: 辛巳，卽皇帝位。
units.en: On xinsi he took the throne.
units.literal: On xinsi he ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 雅好題詩，其序云：「余七歲有詩癖，長而不倦。」
units.en: He loved poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote, "At seven I had a poetry mania, and as I grew I never tired of it."
units.literal: He loved composing poetry by nature; in his preface he wrote: "At seven I had a poetry mania, and in growing up I never tired of it."

units.zh: 然傷於輕豔，當時號曰「宮體」。
units.en: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age called it the "Palace Style."
units.literal: Yet he was faulted for frivolous ornament, and his age styled this the "Palace Style."

units.zh: 所著《昭明太子傳》五卷，《諸王傳》三十卷，《禮大義》二十卷，《老子義》二十卷，《莊子義》二十卷，《長春義記》一百卷，《法寶連璧》三百卷，並行於世焉。
units.en: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his day.
units.literal: His works included Biography of the Heir Apparent Zhaoming in five scrolls, Biographies of the Princes in thirty scrolls, Great Meaning of the Rites in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Laozi in twenty scrolls, Meaning of the Zhuangzi in twenty scrolls, Recorded Meaning of Eternal Spring in one hundred scrolls, and Treasured Laws Linked Pearls in three hundred scrolls—all circulated in his time.

units.zh: 博綜儒書，善言玄理。
units.en: He mastered Confucian classics and was skilled in Neo-Daoist discourse.
units.literal: Broadly versed in Confucian books, skilled in discoursing on Dark Learning.

units.zh: 高祖所制《五經講疏》，嘗於玄圃奉述，聽者傾朝野。
units.en: When Gaozu composed his Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once lectured on them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.
units.literal: When Gaozu composed Expositions on the Five Classics, Taizong once presented them at the Dark Garden; listeners filled court and countryside.

units.zh: 是歲，丁所生穆貴嬪喪，上表陳解，詔還攝本任。
units.en: That year, when his birth mother Honored Consort Mu died, he asked to resign but was ordered back to his post.
units.literal: That year, on mourning for his birth mother Honored Consort Mu, he submitted a memorial requesting release; an edict ordered him to resume his original duties.

units.zh: 天監二年十月丁未，生於顯陽殿。
units.en: On dingwei in the tenth month of Tianjian 2 he was born in Xianyang Hall.
units.literal: In the tenth month, day dingwei, year 2 of Tianjian, he was born in Xianyang Hall.

units.zh: 旣醉寢，王偉、彭儁進土囊，王修纂坐其上，於是太宗崩於永福省，時年四十九。
units.en: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat on it—and Taizong died in Yongfu Palace at the age of forty-nine.
units.literal: When he was drunk and asleep, Wang Wei and Peng Jun brought in a bag of earth; Wang Xiuzuan sat upon it—and thereupon Taizong died in Yongfu Palace, aged forty-nine.

units.zh: 太清三年五月丙辰，高祖崩。
units.en: On bingchen in the fifth month of Taiqing 3 Gaozu died.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day bingchen, year 3 of Taiqing, the Gaozu died.

units.zh: 八年，為雲麾將軍，領石頭戍軍事，量置佐吏。
units.en: In year 8 he became General of the Cloud Banner, took charge of Shitou garrison affairs, and had aides appointed as required.
units.literal: In year 8 he was made General of the Cloud Banner, supervising military affairs at the Shitou garrison, with assistant officials appointed as needed.

units.zh: 九年，遷使持節、都督南北兗青徐冀五州諸軍事、宣毅將軍、南兗州刺史。
units.en: In year 9 he was made Bearer of the Staff and commander of the five Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji provinces, General Who Proclaims Resolution, and South Yanzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 9 he was transferred to Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the five provinces North and South Yan, Qing, Xu, and Ji, made General Who Proclaims Resolution and South Yanzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 十二年，入為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In year 12 he entered court as General Who Proclaims Grace and intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: In year 12 he entered the capital as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 十三年，出為使持節、都督荊雍梁南北秦益寧七州諸軍事、南蠻校尉、荊州刺史，將軍如故。
units.en: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Jing, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, Yi, and Ning, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians, and Jingzhou inspector, retaining his generalship.
units.literal: In year 13 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Jing, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, Yi, and Ning, made Colonel of the Southern Barbarians and Jingzhou Inspector, his generalship unchanged.

units.zh: 十四年，徙為都督江州諸軍事、雲麾將軍、江州刺史，持節如故。
units.en: In year 14 he was reassigned commander of Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner, and Jiangzhou inspector, still Bearer of the Staff.
units.literal: In year 14 he was reassigned as Commander over military affairs in Jiangzhou, General of the Cloud Banner and Jiangzhou Inspector, Bearer of the Staff unchanged.

units.zh: 十七年，徵為西中郎將、領石頭戍軍事，尋復為宣惠將軍、丹陽尹，加侍中。
units.en: In year 17 he was recalled as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West with Shitou garrison duties, then again General Who Proclaims Grace and Danyang intendant, with Palace Attendant added.
units.literal: In year 17 he was summoned as Leader of the Palace Gentlemen of the West, supervising the Shitou garrison; soon restored as General Who Proclaims Grace and Intendant of Danyang, additionally made Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 未拜，改授雲麾將軍、南徐州刺史。
units.en: before taking office he was reassigned General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: before assuming the post, he was reassigned as General of the Cloud Banner and South Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 四年，徙為使持節、都督雍梁、南北秦四州郢州之竟陵司州之隨郡諸軍事，平西將軍、寧蠻校尉、雍州刺史。
units.en: In year 4 he was reassigned Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and related districts, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 4 he was reassigned as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in Yong and Liang, North and South Qin, the four provinces, Jingzhou's Jingling, and Sizhou's Su commandery, made General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel of Pacified Barbarians, and Yongzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 五年，進號安北將軍。
units.en: In year 5 he was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.
units.literal: In year 5 he was advanced to General Who Pacifies the North.

units.zh: 二年，徵為都督南揚、徐二州諸軍事、驃騎將軍、揚州刺史。
units.en: In year 2 he was recalled as commander of South Yang and Xu, General of Agile Cavalry, and Yangzhou inspector.
units.literal: In year 2 he was summoned as Commander over military affairs in South Yang and Xu, made General of Agile Cavalry and Yangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 七月乙亥，臨軒策拜，以脩繕東宮，權居東府。
units.en: On yihai in the seventh month he was invested at the throne hall; while the Eastern Palace was repaired he lodged temporarily at the Eastern Mansion.
units.literal: On yihai in the seventh month, the enthronement ceremony was held at the imperial hall; because the Eastern Palace was under repair, he temporarily resided at the Eastern Mansion.

units.zh: 普通元年，出為使持節、都督益寧雍梁南北秦沙七州諸軍事、益州刺史；
units.en: In Putong 1 he went out as Bearer of the Staff, commander of Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, the two Qin, and Sha, and Yi province inspector;
units.literal: In year 1 of Putong he went out as Bearer of the Staff, Commander over military affairs in the seven provinces Yi, Ning, Yong, Liang, North and South Qin, and Sha, and made Yi Province Inspector;

units.zh: 三年四月乙巳，昭明太子薨。
units.en: On yisi in the fourth month of year 3 Crown Prince Zhaoming died.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day yisi, year 3, Crown Prince Zhaoming died.

units.zh: 大寶元年春正月辛亥朔，以國哀不朝會。
units.en: On xinhai, the new-year's day of Dabao 1, national mourning prevented the court assembly.
units.literal: On xinhai, the first day of the first month of spring in year 1 of Dabao, because of national mourning there was no court assembly.

units.zh: 可大赦天下，改太清四年為大寶元年。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed and Taiqing 4 is changed to Dabao 1."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed; Taiqing year 4 is changed to Dabao year 1."

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕以不造，夙丁閔凶。
units.en: An edict said, "Ill-fated as I am, I have long borne this grief.
units.literal: An edict said: "Our lack of fortune afflicts us; from early we suffered this calamity.

units.zh: 大行皇帝奄棄萬國，攀慕號躃，厝身靡所。
units.en: The late emperor has suddenly left the myriad realms; in longing and wailing I have nowhere to set myself.
units.literal: The late emperor suddenly abandoned the myriad realms; we cling and wail and have nowhere to place ourselves.

units.zh: 猥以寡德，越居民上，煢煢在疚，罔知所託，方賴籓輔，社稷用安。
units.en: With slight virtue I have undeservedly risen above the people; alone in grief I know not whom to trust, and must rely on the feudatories to keep the altars secure.
units.literal: Unworthily with slight virtue we have crossed above the people; alone in anguish we know not where to lean, yet rely on the feudal helpers that the altars may be secure.

units.zh: 謹遵先旨，顧命遺澤，宜加億兆。
units.en: Respectfully following the prior command and the grace of the deathbed charge, the hundred millions should receive added benefit.
units.literal: Respectfully following the prior will and the bequeathed grace of the final charge, benefit should be added for the hundred millions.

units.zh: 可大赦天下。」
units.en: A general amnesty is proclaimed for the empire."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed for the empire."

units.zh: 詔曰：「蓋天下者，至公之神器，在昔三五，不獲已而臨蒞之。
units.en: An edict said, "All under Heaven is the sacred vessel of utmost fairness; in antiquity the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors took the throne only when they could not refuse.
units.literal: An edict said: "All under Heaven is the sacred vessel of utmost fairness; in ages past the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors took the throne only because they had no choice.

units.zh: 故帝王之功，聖人之餘事。
units.en: Thus the work of emperors and kings is what sages leave as surplus.
units.literal: Thus the achievement of emperors and kings is what sages leave over.

units.zh: 軒冕之華，儻來之一物。
units.en: Chariot and cap are adornments that come by chance alone.
units.literal: The glory of chariot and cap is something that came by chance.

units.zh: 太祖文皇帝含光大之量，啓西伯之基。
units.en: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor held vast hidden brilliance and laid the foundation of the Western Earl.
units.literal: Grand Ancestor the Literary Emperor embraced a great measure of hidden light and opened the foundation of the Western Earl.

units.zh: 高祖武皇帝道洽二儀，智周萬物。
units.en: Gaozu the Martial Emperor made the Way fill the two principles and his wisdom encompass the myriad things.
units.literal: The Martial Emperor, the Gaozu, made the Way pervade the two principles and wisdom compass the myriad things.

units.zh: 屬齊季薦瘥，彝倫剝喪，同氣離入苑之禍，元首懷無厭之欲，乃當樂推之運，因億兆之心，承彼掎角，雪茲讎恥。
units.en: When Qi neared its end pestilence returned and moral order collapsed, kin suffered the calamity of the park, and the ruler nursed insatiable desires—then came the fortune of willing elevation, the hearts of the hundred millions were followed, their allied strength was taken up, and this shame was avenged.
units.literal: When the late Qi era brought repeated pestilence and constant norms were stripped away, flesh-and-blood kin suffered the calamity of entering the park, and the ruler harbored insatiable desire—then we met the fortune of the people's willing elevation, drew on the hearts of the hundred millions, received their allied support, and avenged this shame.

units.zh: 事非為己，義寔從民。
units.en: The deed was not for oneself; in righteousness one truly followed the people.
units.literal: The affair was not for oneself; in righteousness one truly followed the people.

units.zh: 故功成弗居，卑宮菲食，大慈之業普薰，汾陽之詔屢下。
units.en: Therefore when the work was done he did not keep it, dwelt in low halls and ate plain food, great compassion spread widely, and edicts like those of Fenyang were issued again and again.
units.literal: Therefore when achievement was done he did not dwell on it, lived in low halls and plain food, the great compassionate enterprise broadly perfumed, and edicts like those of Fenyang were repeatedly issued.

units.zh: 于茲四紀，無得而稱。
units.en: For four reign cycles there has been no fully fitting praise.
units.literal: For four reign cycles now, none can fully praise it.

units.zh: 朕以寡昧，哀煢孔棘，生靈已盡，志不圖全，僶俛視陰，企承鴻緒。
units.en: I, slight and dull, am in deepest grief and distress; the living are exhausted and my will does not aim at wholeness; bowing low I await shade and hope to inherit the great succession.
units.literal: We, slight and dull, in deepest grief and distress—the living souls are spent and our will does not plan for wholeness; we bend low and look to shade, hoping to inherit the great thread.

units.zh: 懸旌履薄，未足云喻。
units.en: Banners hang over thin ice—words can scarcely tell it.
units.literal: Suspended banners over thin ice—words barely suffice.

units.zh: 痛甚愈遲，諒闇彌切。
units.en: Pain deepens as recovery is slow; mourning seclusion grows keener still.
units.literal: Pain grows deeper as healing delays; the period of hidden mourning is all the keener.

units.zh: 方當玄默在躬，栖心事外。
units.en: I should keep dark silence within and lodge my mind outside affairs.
units.literal: We should keep dark silence within and lodge the mind in matters beyond.

units.zh: 卽王道未直，天步猶艱，式憑宰輔，以弘庶政。
units.en: Yet the kingly Way is not yet straight and the heavenly steps still hard; I must rely on chief ministers to broaden the myriad affairs of state.
units.literal: Yet the kingly Way is not yet straight and the heavenly course still hard—we must rely on chief ministers to expand the myriad administrations.

units.zh: 履端建號，仰惟舊章。
units.en: At the year's beginning I establish the era name, looking up to the old statutes.
units.literal: Observing the year's beginning, we establish the era name, looking up to the old statutes.

units.zh: 冬十月壬寅，帝謂舍人殷不害曰：「吾昨夜夢吞土，卿試為我思之。」
units.en: On renyin in the tenth month of winter the emperor said to attendant Yin Buhai, "Last night I dreamed I swallowed earth—please interpret it for me."
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, day renyin, the Emperor said to Attendant Yin Buhai: "Last night I dreamed I swallowed earth—try to interpret it for me."

units.zh: 帝笑曰：「壽酒，不得盡此乎？」
units.en: The emperor smiled and said, "Longevity wine—must it not be drunk to the dregs?"
units.literal: The Emperor smiled and said: "Longevity wine—must it not be drunk to the end?"

units.zh: 帝知不免，乃盡酣，曰：「不圖為樂一至於斯！」
units.en: Knowing he could not escape, the emperor drank his fill and said, "I never thought merriment could come to this!"
units.literal: Knowing he could not escape, the Emperor drank his fill and said: "I never thought pleasure could reach this point!"

units.zh: 弗欺暗室，豈況三光，數至於此，命也如何！」
units.en: I would not deceive a dark room—how much less the sun, moon, and stars; to come to this count is fate—what can be done!"
units.literal: I would not deceive a dark room—how much less the three luminaries; to reach this number is fate—what can be done!"

units.zh: 又為《連珠》二首，文甚悽愴。
units.en: He also wrote two "Linked Pearls" pieces, their tone deeply mournful.
units.literal: He also composed two Linked Pearls pieces, the text deeply mournful.

units.zh: 在襄陽拜表北伐，遣長史柳津、司馬董當門，壯武將軍杜懷寶、振遠將軍曹義宗等衆軍進討，剋平南陽、新野等郡，魏南荊州刺史李志據安昌城降，拓地千餘里。
units.en: At Xiangyang he memorialized for a northern campaign and sent chief clerk Liu Jin, marshal Dong Dangmen, martial valor general Du Huaibao, far-shaking general Cao Yizong, and others with the armies; they took Nanyang, Xinye, and other commanderies, Wei's south Jingzhou inspector Li Zhi surrendered Anchang fortress, and territory expanded more than a thousand li.
units.literal: At Xiangyang he memorialized for a northern campaign; he sent Chief Clerk Liu Jin, Marshal Dong Dangmen, Martial Valor General Du Huaibao, Far-Shaking General Cao Yizong, and others with the massed armies on expedition, conquering Nanyang, Xinye, and other commanderies; Wei's South Jingzhou Inspector Li Zhi, holding Anchang fortress, surrendered, and territory was extended more than a thousand li.

units.zh: 方頰豊下，須鬢如畫，眄睞則目光燭人。
units.en: Square of cheek and full below, beard and temples like painted lines; a sidelong glance lit upon men like fire.
units.literal: Square of cheek and full below, his beard and temples like a painting; when he glanced sidelong his gaze lit upon men.

units.zh: 篇章辭賦，操筆立成。
units.en: in essays, rhapsodies, and verse he took up the brush and finished on the spot.
units.literal: in essays, rhapsodies, and verse he took up the brush and finished at once.

units.zh: 於是並賚酒肴、曲項琵琶，與帝飲。
units.en: They then gave wine and food, a curved-neck pipa, and drank with him.
units.literal: Thereupon they all bestowed wine and food, a curved-neck pipa, and drank with the Emperor.

units.zh: 四月乙丑，葬莊陵。
units.en: On yichou in the fourth month he was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.
units.literal: Fourth month, day yichou, he was buried at Zhuang Mausoleum.

units.zh: 太宗幼而敏睿，識悟過人，六歲便屬文，高祖驚其早就，弗之信也。
units.en: Taizong from childhood was quick and perceptive, his insight beyond others; at six he could write, and Gaozu marveled at his early gift but did not believe it.
units.literal: Taizong from youth was keen and perceptive, his understanding surpassing others; at six he could compose texts, and Gaozu marveled at his early maturity but did not believe it.

units.zh: 簡文帝
units.en: Emperor Jianwen
units.literal: Emperor Jianwen

units.zh: 丙午，侯景逼太宗幸西州。
units.en: On bingwu Hou Jing forced Taizong to go to Xizhou.
units.literal: On bingwu Hou Jing compelled the Taizong to visit Xizhou.

units.zh: 冬十月乙未，侯景又逼太宗幸西州曲宴，自加宇宙大將軍、都督六合諸軍事。
units.en: On yiwei in the tenth month of winter Hou Jing again forced Taizong to a banquet at Xizhou and made himself Grand General of the Cosmos and commander of the Six Harmonized Directions.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day yiwei, Hou Jing again compelled the Taizong to attend a banquet at Xizhou, and himself added Grand General of the Cosmos and Commander over military affairs in the Six Harmonized Directions.

units.zh: 矯為太宗詔，禪于豫章嗣王棟，大赦改年。
units.en: He forged an abdication edict in Taizong's name to the successor prince of Yuzhang, Dong, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the reign title.
units.literal: Forging an edict in Taizong's name, he abdicated to the Successor Prince of Yuzhang, Dong; a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title changed.

units.zh: 及王偉等進觴於帝曰：「丞相以陛下憂憤旣久，使臣上壽。」
units.en: Then Wang Wei and the others came forward with a toast and said, "The chancellor, seeing Your Majesty's long grief, has sent us to offer longevity wine."
units.literal: When Wang Wei and the others came forward with a toast to the Emperor, they said: "The Chancellor, seeing Your Majesty's long grief and distress, has sent us to offer longevity wine."

units.zh: 蕭穎胄旣都督中外諸軍事，論者謂高祖應致牋，域爭不聽，乃止。
units.en: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.
units.literal: When Xiao Yingzhou became area commander of all armies, some said Gaozu should send a formal letter of submission; Yu objected and the idea was dropped.

units.zh: 及郢城平，蕭穎達、楊公則諸將皆欲頓軍夏口，高祖以爲宜乘勢長驅，直指京邑，以計語弘策，弘策與高祖意合。
units.en: After Ying fell, Xiao Yingda and Yang Gongze wanted to camp at Xiakou; Gaozu meant to drive the victory straight to the capital and told Hongce, who agreed.
units.literal: When Ying city was pacified, Xiao Yingda, Yang Gongze, and the other generals all wished to halt the army at Xiakou; Gaozu held that they should press the advantage in a long drive straight at the capital, and he spoke the plan to Hongce—Hongce agreed with Gaozu.

units.zh: 數日，詔公卿問訊，亮無疾色，御史中丞樂藹奏大不敬，論棄市刑。
units.en: Days later an edict sent dukes and ministers to inquire; Liang showed no sickness; censor-in-chief Yue Ai memorialized gross disrespect and asked the death penalty in the marketplace.
units.literal: Several days later an edict had the dukes and ministers inquire; Liang showed no sign of illness; Censor-in-Chief Yue Ai memorialized for gross disrespect, penalty of execution in the marketplace.

units.zh: 遷司徒刑獄參軍事，入爲尚書殿中郎，轉司徒竟陵王記室參軍，以父憂去職。
units.en: He rose to prison staff in the criminal office, then palace attendant in the secretariat, then recorder to the Prince of Jingling, and left for his father's mourning.
units.literal: Promoted to Criminal Office Prison staff officer, entered as Attendant of the Palace Department in the Masters of Writing, then transferred to Staff Officer and Recorder to the Prince of Jingling of the Secretariat, left office for father's mourning.

units.zh: 始高祖與昉遇竟陵王西邸，從容謂昉曰：「我登三府，當以卿爲記室。」
units.en: When Gaozu first met Fang at the Prince of Jingling's western residence, he said lightly, "When I reach the three offices, you shall be my recorder."
units.literal: When Gaozu first met Fang at the Prince of Jingling's Western Residence, he said with ease: "When I rise to the three offices, I shall make you my recorder."

units.zh: 賾與河南元善、河東柳䛒、太原王劭、吳興姚察、琅琊諸葛潁、信都劉焯、河間劉炫相善，每因休假，清談竟日。
units.en: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.
units.literal: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.

units.zh: 及司州城陷，爲御史中丞任昉所奏。
units.en: When Si province fell, Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang impeached him.
units.literal: When Si province's city fell, he was impeached by Censor-in-Chief Ren Fang.

units.zh: 沈攸之難起，太祖入朝堂，豫章王嶷代守東府，使淵領軍屯司徒左府，分備京邑。
units.en: When Shen Youzhi rose, the Founder went into the hall of court; Prince of Yuzhang Yi held the eastern headquarters in his place and set Yuan at the head of troops encamped at the minister of public works' left quarters, dividing the capital for defense.
units.literal: When Shen Youzhi's revolt broke out, the Founder entered the hall of court; the Prince of Yuzhang, Yi, held the Eastern headquarters in his stead and had Yuan lead troops to encamp at the Minister of Public Works' left quarters, dividing forces to guard the capital.

units.zh: 袁粲據石頭，豫章王嶷夜登西門遙呼淵，淵驚起，率軍赴難，先至石頭焚門攻戰。
units.en: Yuan Can held Stone citadel; Prince of Yuzhang Yi climbed the western gate at night and hailed Yuan from afar; Yuan started up in alarm, led his host to the crisis, and was first at Stone citadel—burning the gate and fighting through.
units.literal: Yuan Can held Stone citadel; the Prince of Yuzhang, Yi, climbed the western gate at night and called Yuan from afar; Yuan sprang up in alarm, led his army to the crisis, and was first to reach Stone citadel—burning the gate and fighting through.

units.zh: 齊初，入爲尚書三公郎，累遷太子中舍人，巴東王子響友。
units.en: Early in Qi he entered the secretariat as three-ducal attendant, rose to crown prince gentleman companion, and was made Friend of the Prince of Badong, Zi Xiang.
units.literal: Early in Qi he entered the Masters of Writing as attendant of the Three Ducal Officials, rose through posts to crown prince gentleman companion, and became Friend of the Prince of Badong, Zi Xiang.

units.zh: 子響爲荊州，惔隨之鎮。
units.en: When Zi Xiang went to Jing province, Tan followed him there.
units.literal: When Zi Xiang took Jing province, Tan followed him to the post.

units.zh: 子響昵近小人，惔知將爲禍，稱疾還京。
units.en: Zi Xiang clung to petty men; Tan foresaw ruin, claimed illness, and went back to the capital.
units.literal: Zi Xiang doted on petty men; Tan saw disaster coming, feigned illness, and returned to the capital.

units.zh: 及難作，惔以先歸得免。
units.en: When trouble came, Tan escaped because he had returned first.
units.literal: When the crisis broke, Tan was spared because he had left early.

units.zh: 又嘗侍座，高祖曰：「徐元瑜違命嶺南，《周書》罪不相及，朕已宥其諸子，何如？」
units.en: Another time at court Gaozu said, "Xu Yuanyu rebelled in Lingnan. The Book of Zhou says punishment does not chain to kin—I have pardoned his sons. What say you?"
units.literal: On another occasion, while attending him, Gaozu said: "Xu Yuanyu defied orders in Lingnan—the Book of Zhou says crimes do not reach kin. I have already pardoned his sons. What do you think?"

units.zh: 世祖武皇帝情等布衣，寄深同氣。
units.en: Ancestor Emperor Wu treated him as an equal of the robe and bound him with shared blood.
units.literal: Ancestor Emperor Wu treated him as a commoner's equal and entrusted him with the bond of shared blood.

units.zh: 武皇大漸，實奉詔言。
units.en: When Emperor Wu lay dying, I truly received his charge in words.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu fell gravely ill, I truly received his charge in words.
